stem: How does the author of Finding Dorothy use dialogue DIFFERENTLY than the author of “Big Wheels Keep On Turnin’” uses quotations?

options.label: A
options.text: The dialogue in the excerpt from Finding Dorothy conveys more factual information about new inventions than the quotations in the excerpt from “Big Wheels Keep On Turnin’.”

options.label: B
options.text: The dialogue in the excerpt from Finding Dorothy creates more well-developed characters than the people quoted in the excerpt from “Big Wheels Keep On Turnin’.”

options.label: C
options.text: The dialogue in the excerpt from Finding Dorothy demonstrates less personal interaction between individuals than people quoted in the excerpt from “Big Wheels Keep On Turnin’.”

options.label: D
options.text: The dialogue in the excerpt from Finding Dorothy communicates less disagreement about the fair’s attractions than the quotations in the excerpt from “Big Wheels Keep On Turnin’.”
